summary_text: The school utilizes English as the medium of instruction and offers a curriculum ranging from preschool to IGCSE, IAL, and English Language Training. The academic year generally runs from June to March and is divided into two semesters. Instruction is supported by small and manageable class sizes to provide individual attention.
